notes: stocktaking count entry (ST_STOCK_TAKING): basic quantity / book cost / sales price derived per line, lot required for expiry groups; lot sales price and discount (tk_after_save), file loads (من ملف / CSV), CALC_COST, adjustment status and total quantity (APP_ACT_ST, source ST\FMB\ST_TAKING_fmb.xml)

ST_STOCK_TAKING_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(i.name_a) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_STOCK_TAKING_DET.LOT_NUMBER.sql: (select max(c.lot_number) from st_item_confg c where c.item_confg_id = t.item_confg_id)

ST_STOCK_TAKING_DET.BAL_QTY.sql: round(nvl(get_balance(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.st_taking_date), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3)

ST_STOCK_TAKING_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c where c.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by c.expire_date, c.item_confg_id
